answer: Proof-of-stake juries resist fake identities: a new agent must wander the network as a hollow, untrusted ghost through a reputation decay window before its vote counts, since bonded jurors only accept identities with a stake history reaching a zenith of honest rounds. An attacker flooding sybils must fund each puppets bond and wait out the window per identity, paying capital and time that scales with attack size while honest agents lose nothing.
